en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: This update adds quieter display colors, improves artwork and meter alignment, and keeps all six bars visible in compact regions. Five animal icons are available, with a corgi as the default. Please test simultaneous activities, icon switching and display readability.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 本次更新采用更柔和的显示配色，优化封面与声浪对齐，改善狭窄区域中六条声浪的完整显示。新增五款动物图标，默认使用柯基。请验证多个活动并存时的布局、图标切换与显示辨识度。
